articles.title: US CPI is out tomorrow: why Tuesday's inflation reading is the most important data point of the year
articles.description: IG expected June headline CPI to cool while core inflation remained sticky. It explained that softer inflation typically lifts global risk appetite, while hotter inflation strengthens the dollar and pressures risk assets.

articles.title: BIT: June US CPI Data Emerges as Critical Catalyst for Bitcoin's Next Major Move
articles.description: BIT said a hotter June CPI could reinforce monetary tightening and pressure Bitcoin, while a softer reading could provide relief and trigger a short-term crypto rally.

articles.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $62,000 Ahead of CPI Figures
articles.description: Cointribune described June CPI as a binary Bitcoin catalyst: a lower-than-expected figure could revive dovish Fed expectations and support a move toward $65,000, while a hot reading could trigger liquidations.

articles.title: Will Bitcoin Price Jump 10% Today as U.S. CPI Data Looms?
articles.description: The Crypto Times said a significantly cooler core CPI could weaken expectations for further Fed tightening and support Bitcoin, while a hotter reading could cause the opposite reaction. It cautioned that correlation alone would not prove CPI caused a full rally.

articles.title: Consumer Price Index - June 2026
articles.description: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported at 8:30 a.m. ET that headline CPI fell 0.4% in June, its largest monthly decline since April 2020; annual CPI slowed to 3.5% and core CPI was unchanged monthly at 2.6% annually.

articles.title: Critical US Inflation Data Released: What Was Bitcoin's Initial Reaction?
articles.description: BitcoinSistemi reported headline and core CPI below expectations at 12:32 UTC. Its embedded Binance BTCUSDT chart showed a +0.81% 15-minute candle from $62,957.96 to $63,465.97 with a large volume spike immediately after the release.
